preconditions.description: The number of factories N must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of businessmen M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of years Q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= parent[i] <= i for i in range(1, N))
preconditions.description: Each factory's parent must be a valid factory index less than or equal to the factory's index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= M for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each factory must be owned by a valid businessman index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= threshold[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each businessman's threshold must be between 1 and 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N and 1 <= X <= 10**6 and 0 <= D <= 10**6 for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each donation report must have valid factory index F, amount X, and dependency multiplier D.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly M lines, one for each businessman.

postconditions.expression: all(line in {'rekt', str(year)} for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line must either be 'rekt' or a valid year number.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) <= Q for line in stdout.splitlines() if line != 'rekt')
postconditions.description: Each valid year number must be less than or equal to the number of years Q.
